description: This is a PHP unit test class for testing the QuickLaunchDao class within the OrangeHRM Dashboard module, specifically testing its methods that retrieve quick launch link lists based on fixture data.

classes.name: QuickLaunchDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the QuickLaunchDao methods related to fetching quick launch links, using fixtures for different configurations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of QuickLaunchDao, sets the fixture directory, and sets up mock services.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchList1
methods.description: Tests retrieval of quick launch list when modules are enabled and periods are defined.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchListForESS1
methods.description: Tests retrieval of quick launch list for Employee Self Service when modules are enabled and periods are defined.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchList2
methods.description: Tests retrieval of quick launch list when modules are enabled but periods are undefined.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchListForESS2
methods.description: Tests retrieval of ESS quick launch list when modules are enabled but periods are undefined.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchList3
methods.description: Tests retrieval when the leave module is disabled, expecting only time module links.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchListForESS3
methods.description: Tests the ESS quick launch list when leave module is disabled, expecting only time module links.
